workbook: 4. Appendix-II MYT Tariff Formats ARR FY 2026-27.xlsx
note: The true-up year's power purchase as billed (PPC FY 25, rows 11–58: long-term, medium-term, short-term and renewable sources, the RTM sale and DSM; subtotals skipped).  Per source: billed (P = fixed + energy + other), net of rebate (R), with transmission (V), the rate on the energy billed (L), the cost per unit at NPCL's bus (W) and the inter-state, intra-state and total losses (G, I, K).  Totals: the net cost (V60) the ARR carries as power purchase (row 20 = the grand total less transmission and arrears), the bills (P60), the rebate (Q60) and the energy at the bus (J60, the ARR's row 8).

blank_is_zero.why: NPCL leaves a cell blank where a source has none — a charge it does not bill, or energy for a charges-only row (the JITPL incentive, row 25); its totals (P = SUM(M:O), R = P − Q, U = S + T, V = U + R, the SUBTOTALs of F, H, J) read the blanks as zero.  A row with no energy has no rate or loss (blocked, never 0).
